name: Tanba Law Office
description: A law office theme in old purple: a formal white top header with an ink side rail; the first screen sets a tall old-purple banner with the firm line and a low-key office photograph beside a narrow centred column with a matter search, six filter chips and the first rows of a numbered practice index, with a cut-out desk lamp breaking over it; then the full eighteen-row index in four groups, three ways to engage, sectors, four partners and a contact strip. English sample content.

design.illustration: low-key (50mm f/1.8, single warm window light, deep shadow, fine grain, graded toward old purple)

fonts.role: headings, the firm line, practice names, sectors and figures (Regular, Medium and SemiBold, Latin subsets)
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2021 The Shippori Mincho Project Authors

fonts.role: body text, labels, the index columns, the side rail, forms and buttons (variable roman and italic, Latin subset)
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2021 The Hanken Grotesk Project Authors

summary.en: Old-purple law office theme: side rail, tall banner beside a practice index with search and filter chips, 18 numbered rows, partners.

summary.ja: 古代紫の法律事務所テーマ。サイドレール、縦長バナーと中央の検索・絞り込み付き取扱分野索引、18行の番号付き一覧、依頼方法、パートナー。
